name: vn.vucar/vucar-mcp
title: Vucar MCP
description: Look up car names, estimate used-car prices and submit sell requests in Vietnam via Vucar.

tools.name: vucar_how_selling_works
tools.description: Explains the Vucar process (submit, free inspection, dealers bid in an auction, owner decides), the fees (no listing fee; 1-2% service fee only after a successful sale, rate confirmed before closing) and contact details (hotline 1800 646 896, vucar.vn). Static information, no side effects. / Giải thích quy trình bán xe, phí và liên hệ của Vucar.

tools.name: vucar_car_catalog
tools.description: Lists the car catalog Vucar uses for valuation. With no input it lists brands; with brand it lists models; with brand+model it lists years; with brand+model+year it lists variants. Use it to map the owner's free text to exact names before vucar_estimate_price. Lists are capped. Read-only. / Tra cứu tên hãng, dòng, năm, phiên bản chính xác.

brand.description: Car brand, e.g. toyota. Use vucar_car_catalog for exact names.

model.description: Car model, e.g. vios. Use vucar_car_catalog for exact names.

tools.name: vucar_estimate_price
tools.description: Returns an indicative price range in VND for a used car in Vietnam, rounded to the nearest 5,000,000 VND. It is not an offer: the final price comes from Vucar's inspection and dealer bidding. Use exact names from vucar_car_catalog. Rate limited. Read-only. / Ước tính khoảng giá tham khảo (VND); giá cuối cùng do kiểm định và đấu giá quyết định.

brand.description: Car brand, e.g. toyota. Use vucar_car_catalog for exact names.

model.description: Car model, e.g. vios. Use vucar_car_catalog for exact names.

variant.description: Variant/trim exactly as listed by vucar_car_catalog

tools.name: vucar_sell_send_otp
tools.description: Step 1 of submitting a car. Sends a 5-digit code to the owner's phone via Zalo; it expires in 2 minutes. Ask the OWNER to read the code to you and pass it to vucar_sell_car. Never guess or invent a code. Only call this with the owner's consent. Rate limited. / Gửi mã OTP 5 số tới điện thoại chủ xe qua Zalo; hãy nhờ chủ xe đọc mã cho bạn, không đoán mã.

phone.description: Owner's Vietnamese mobile number, e.g. 0912345678 or +84912345678

tools.name: vucar_sell_car
tools.description: Step 2 of submitting a car. Creates a real sell request for a Vucar specialist to follow up (they call the owner to book a free inspection; the owner is not obliged to sell). Requires the owner's consent and the 5-digit code the OWNER received from vucar_sell_send_otp; without a valid code nothing is recorded. Free-text fields are length-limited. Rate limited. / Gửi yêu cầu bán xe; cần OTP do chủ xe đọc.

phone.description: Owner's Vietnamese mobile number, e.g. 0912345678 or +84912345678

otp.description: The 5-digit code the OWNER received and read out to you

brand.description: Car brand, e.g. toyota. Use vucar_car_catalog for exact names.

model.description: Car model, e.g. vios. Use vucar_car_catalog for exact names.

variant.description: Variant/trim exactly as listed by vucar_car_catalog

location.description: Province/city where the car is, e.g. Hà Nội, TP.HCM

expected_price_vnd.description: Owner's asking price in VND, if they gave one

note.description: Optional note from the owner about the car (max 500 chars)
